title: ReasoningShield: Safety Detection over Reasoning Traces of Large Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.17244v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) leverage explicit reasoning traces, known as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, to decompose complex problems into intermediate steps before deriving final answers. However, these reasoning traces introduce unique safety challenges: harmful content can be embedded in intermediate steps even when final answers appear benign. Our study reveals that existing state-of-the-art moderation tools experience significant performance degradation on CoT moderation, with F1 scores dropping by up to 35.2% compared to traditional answer moderation. To address these challenges, we present ReasoningShield, a comprehensive benchmark and a suite of strong lightweight models for CoT safety moderation. translated_title: ReasoningShield：面向大型推理模型推理轨迹的安全检测
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型利用显式推理轨迹（即思维链CoT推理）在得出最终答案之前将复杂问题分解为中间步骤。然而，这些推理轨迹带来了独特的安全挑战：即使最终答案看似无害，有害内容也可能嵌入在中间步骤中。我们的研究表明，现有最先进的内容审核工具在CoT审核方面出现了显著的性能下降，与传统答案审核相比，F1分数下降高达35.2%。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ReasoningShield，这是一个全面的基准测试以及一套强大的轻量级模型，用于CoT安全审核。我们的基准包含9.2K个带标注的（查询，CoT）对，具有结构化的分步风险分析，包括一个7K样本的训练集和一个2.2K的人工标注测试集，涵盖10个风险类别、3个安全等级，……
tldr: 大型推理模型的思维链中间步骤中可能隐藏有害内容，导致现有审核工具性能大幅下降，本文提出ReasoningShield基准与轻量级模型，用于对CoT推理轨迹进行安全审核。
en_tdlr: ReasoningShield addresses the safety risk that harmful content can be hidden in Chain-of-Thought intermediate steps of Large Reasoning Models, by providing a comprehensive benchmark of 9.2K annotated (Query, CoT) pairs and a suite of strong lightweight models for CoT safety moderation.
